items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: This was a booker, trying to get me some work and he used to be Benny Goodman's man, the booker.

ctx.x: I can't understand it. Some day I'm going to ask Willard Alexander that too. This was a booker, trying to get me some work and he used to be Benny Goodman's man, the booker.
I'm going to ask him some time, how come?
